scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && copyfiles -u 1 ./**/*.graphql dist/ && node -e "import('./dist/factories/GraphQLSchema.js').then(({resolvers}) => { if (!resolvers.Query?.fetchService || !resolvers.Mutation?.dockerRestart) throw new Error('compiled GraphQL resolvers were not loaded') })" && node -e "Object.assign(process.env, {DRAX_DB_ENGINE: 'sqlite', DRAX_SQLITE_FILE: 'smoke.db', DRAX_JWT_SECRET: 'smoke', DRAX_PORT: '0'}); import('./dist/index.js').then(() => { console.log('Smoke test passed'); process.exit(0) }).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1) })"
